description: On-chain control path of an EVM contract or Safe: proxy type and implementation; proxy admin, beacon owner, owner(), DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders, Aave PoolAddressesProvider owner, Morpho vault curator/guardian/timelock; each resolved through ProxyAdmin, Safe threshold and signers, timelock delay or Avocado wallet; plus a verdict (SINGLE KEY, MULTISIG NO TIMELOCK, TIMELOCKED, UNRESOLVED). For a Safe address: signers, threshold, modules, guard, fallback handler, singleton. Chains: ethereum (1), optimism (10), bsc (56), unichain (130), polygon (137), sonic (146), zksync (324), hyperevm (999), base (8453), arbitrum (42161), avalanche (43114), linea (59144), berachain (80094), blast (81457), katana (747474). Free, 100 calls/day.
